title: 第七章 大雄宝殿内第八章 杀戮
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
少华山少林寺，大雄宝殿。
如昨日那般，心寂方丈一一询问了孟奇等人的经历。
就在此时，一道人影如鬼魅般从孟奇等人中窜出，一掌拍向心寂方丈。
是彪形大汉向辉！
或者说，他是‘百变书生’邝承望！是朵儿察手下有四大先天高手之一。
早在孟奇等人遭遇第二次截杀时，真正的向辉便死去了，后来的向辉皆是由百变书生假扮的。所图的，就是这出其不意的偷袭，只要他能一掌击伤半步‘禅境’的心寂方丈，少林寺再无人可以与大将军朵儿察对抗！
“阿弥陀佛！”
心寂方丈早有预料的回击一掌，看那成竹在胸的模样，哪有半点被偷袭的惊慌？
双掌相对，百变书生眼中闪过惊慌疑惑不解。不明白是哪出的破绽，导致偷袭失败。
知道计划暴露，他顺势就要借着心寂的掌力脱离众人，逃之夭夭日后再报此仇。
“锵！”
两声剑鸣传来，张远山江芷薇两人一左一右欺身上前，早有准备的封锁了百变书生的退路。
这个小娘皮竟也是一个先天高手！
他今日来时打听过镇河洛的死因，知道张远山的实力，但是万万没有想到，看上去也就十五左右的少女也是一位不弱的先天高手，不，她比斩杀了镇河洛的张远山还强！
百变书生以易容、伪装和轻功闻名，短短一个呼吸内，他就在极小空间内闪转腾挪，躲避两人的招式。
该死！怎么会有如此厉害的剑客？
游走躲避的百变书生吓得亡魂大冒。他感觉到一道森寒剑意死死锁定眉心，哪怕他再怎么腾挪闪避，也无法避开这种感觉。就好像此剑有灵，不管他怎么样都会刺进眉心。
打定主意找个肉盾抵达此剑锋芒，百变书生身形扭转间如同鬼魅般连连闪动，来到林阳面前。
山野村夫。
知道林阳‘真实身份’的百变书生打定主意要他做这个替死鬼，在场没有比他更合适的人选。只要此劫一过，他就能逃之夭夭。

“好！”
林阳眼前一亮，他本来看着几人交手速度极快，怕自身上去会帮了倒忙所以一直在观战，没想到这人竟会自己送上门来。
向前拍出一掌，后发先至的击中百变书生胸膛。
砰！
百变书生刹那间就像是断了线的风筝倒飞出去，倒在心寂方丈脚下。
“你，你……”
七窍流血的他颤颤巍巍的伸手指着林阳说不出话，本想硬抗一掌换取逃生时机，哪曾想这村夫一拳就让他五脏俱碎。
“阿弥陀佛！”
心寂方丈念了声佛号，低头仿佛看出了百变书生的不解，他道“早先尔等上山时，林施主便告诉我你伪装成他的同伴，只不过顾忌你轻功莫测，怕你逃脱才在此地布下种种网罗。果然你和林施主猜测的一样，是为了老僧而来。”
在客房时张远山听出林阳话中含义，并通过传音入密商定好计划。
百变书生瞪大带着血丝的眼睛直盯盯的看着林阳，接着身子软软瘫在地上。
此刻，大殿中拈花微笑的佛陀座下有火苗蹿起，组成一行字。
“支线任务一杀死敌对阵营四大先天高手之中的‘百变书生’，林阳奖励五十善功，张远山、江芷薇各奖励二十善功。”
“支线任务描述杀死敌对阵营四大先天高手之一，参与者既根据任务难度、实力对比、出力程度获得相应善功奖励。”
“支线任务二开启杀死大将军朵儿察，参与者根据贡献，奖励五十到两百善功不等！”
从百变书生出手偷袭到身死加起来不过几个呼吸，孟奇看到任务提示才想明白是怎么个情况，原来向辉早就身死，这两天一路走来的队友一直是敌人！
这时，孟奇想起客栈中林阳的话，猛地打了一个寒颤，果然，是够幸运的！如果百变书生当初要易容成他，自己恐怕早就暴尸荒野了。
“阿弥陀佛。”
心寂再次念了一声佛号，他缓缓开口“还请几位施主看守后山，以防贼人攀爬山岩偷袭。”
content_en:
Shaohua Mountain Shaolin Temple, Main Hall.
Just like yesterday, Abbot Xinji asked Meng Qi and others about their experiences one by one.
At this moment, a figure sprang out from Meng Qi and the others like a ghost, and slapped Abbot Xinji with a palm.
It's Xiang Hui, a sturdy man!
In other words, he is the ‘Various Scholar’ Kuang Chengwang! He is one of the four innate masters under Duo Ercha.
As early as when Meng Qi and others encountered the second interception, the real Xiang Hui died, and the subsequent Xiang Hui was all pretended by the versatile scholar. What he planned was this unexpected sneak attack. As long as he could injure Abbot Xinji, who was half a step into the Zen realm, with one palm, no one in the Shaolin Temple could stand up to General Duoercha!
"Amitabha!"
Abbot Xinji had already expected a slap in return. Looking at his confident look, how could he be at all panicked about being attacked?
With both palms facing each other, panic and confusion flashed in the eyes of the versatile scholar. I don’t know what flaw caused the sneak attack to fail.
Knowing that the plan was exposed, he took advantage of the situation and used the power of Xinji's palm to get away from everyone, escape and take revenge later.
"Qiang!"
Two sword sounds were heard, and Zhang Yuanshan and Jiang Zhiwei stepped forward, one on the left and the other on the right, blocking the Variety Scholar's escape route in advance.
This little girl is actually an innate master!
When he came today, he inquired about the cause of Zhen Heluo's death and knew Zhang Yuanshan's strength, but he never expected that the girl who looked about fifteen years old was also a powerful innate master. No, she was stronger than Zhang Yuanshan who killed Zhen Heluo!
The ever-changing scholar is famous for his disguise, disguise, and Qinggong. In just one breath, he moved around in a very small space, avoiding the two people's moves.
Damn it! How could there be such a powerful swordsman?
The ever-changing scholar who was wandering around and hiding was so frightened that he lost his soul. He felt a cold sword intent locking tightly between his eyebrows. No matter how much he moved to dodge, he could not avoid this feeling. It was as if the sword had a spirit, and it would pierce the center of his eyebrow no matter what he did.
Making up his mind to find a human shield to reach the edge of the sword, the ever-changing scholar's figure twisted and flashed like a ghost, and came to Lin Yang.
A mountain villager.
The versatile scholar who knew Lin Yang's 'true identity' made up his mind to make him the scapegoat, and there was no more suitable candidate than him. As long as this disaster is over, he can escape.
"Okay!"
Lin Yang's eyes lit up. He had watched several people fighting at a very fast speed. He was afraid that he would be a disservice if he went up, so he kept watching the battle. He didn't expect that this person would actually come to his door.
He clapped his palm forward and hit the versatile scholar's chest first and second.
Bang!
In an instant, the versatile scholar flew out like a kite with its string cut off, and fell at the feet of Abbot Xinji.
"You, you..."
With bleeding from all his orifices, he pointed tremblingly at Lin Yang and was speechless. He wanted to resist a slap in exchange for a chance to escape, but he never thought that this villager would shatter his internal organs with one punch.
"Amitabha!"
Abbot Xinji recited the Buddha's name, and lowered his head as if he could see the confusion of the various scholars. He said, "Earlier when you went up the mountain, Donor Lin told me that you were pretending to be his companion. He was just worried about your unpredictability and was afraid that you would escape, so he laid all kinds of traps here. Sure enough, you are here for the old monk, just as Donor Lin guessed."
In the guest room, Zhang Yuanshan heard the meaning of Lin Yang's words and made a plan through sound transmission.
The versatile scholar stared at Lin Yang with wide, bloodshot eyes, and then his body fell limply to the ground.
At this moment, in the main hall, under the seat of the Buddha holding flowers and smiling, flames jumped up, forming a line of words.
"Side mission one kills the 'Various Scholar' among the four innate masters of the enemy camp. Lin Yang will be rewarded with fifty good deeds, and Zhang Yuanshan and Jiang Zhiwei will each be rewarded with twenty good deeds."
"The side task describes killing one of the four innate masters of the enemy camp. Participants will receive corresponding good merit rewards based on the difficulty of the task, strength comparison, and level of contribution."
"Side mission 2 starts and kills the generalIn Dorcha, participants will be rewarded with rewards ranging from fifty to two hundred good deeds based on their contribution! "
The total time from the versatile scholar's sneak attack to his death only took a few breaths. Meng Qi saw the mission prompts and figured out what was going on. It turned out that Xiang Hui had died a long time ago, and his teammates who had been along the way for the past two days had always been enemies!
At this time, Meng Qi thought of Lin Yang's words in the inn and shuddered suddenly. Sure enough, he was lucky enough! If the versatile scholar had wanted to disguise himself as him, he would have died in the wilderness long ago.
“Amitabha. "
Xinji recited the Buddha's name again, and he slowly said, "I also asked a few donors to guard the back mountain to prevent thieves from climbing up the rocks to attack. "
